video_title: Isiah Thomas on Wemby Living Up to SKY HIGH Expectations?!?

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas names Jalen Brunson as the Knicks' most consistent player
quotes.excerpt: He's been the most consistent best player on both teams.
quotes.quote: He's been the most consistent best player on both teams. When I say consistent, when you look at what he's shooting, how he's playing, what he's doing when he's out on the floor, he's been the man.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas defends Jalen Brunson against analytics-based criticism
quotes.excerpt: This is where the analytics get you all screwed up.
quotes.quote: This is where the analytics get you all screwed up. Oh, well he's only shooting 33% from the field and he's got 23 points. Then you go to the other column and you say, damn, the little fella averaging 29 points in this series.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas defines the small guard archetype in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to say 6'3" and under. Curry did it at 6'3" more or less shooting, scoring.
quotes.quote: I'm going to say 6'3" and under. Curry did it at 6'3" more or less shooting, scoring. Brunson and I, if Brunson becomes a champion, we did it scoring and assisting. I take Magic and I put him in the freak category at 6'9" because that, and then he had Kareem, so okay. But Brunson and I, scoring and assisting, that is something totally different.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas compares Victor Wembanyama's potential to Kareem Abdul-Jabbar and LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: We jumped the gun when Kareem was dominating the league and then Magic came along.
quotes.quote: We jumped the gun when Kareem was dominating the league and then Magic came along. He hadn't won a championship yet, but he became the face of the league and we saw the potential in him. Jordan had a chance to be something different than any of us, so we saw that, hey man, he could possibly be the best one to ever do this. And then LeBron James came along and all of y'all knew like LeBron, he was on a different level than y'all, so he became the face. Now with Wemby coming, you're looking at Wemby and you're saying, he ain't like no other big man we've ever seen.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas claims jealousy drives the exclusion of LeBron James from top-five lists
quotes.excerpt: They intentionally ignore the obvious. And when you intentionally ignore the obvious, then that has to come back to some jealousy.
quotes.quote: They intentionally ignore the obvious. And when you intentionally ignore the obvious, then that has to come back to some jealousy or envy or just some straight-up BS. This man got every basketball record on the books and he ain't in your top five, you full of shit.
